goal: Protect nodes from memory exhaustion attacks caused by peers sending worst-case blocks or transactions
Reject impossible transactions early during deserialization rather than allocating memory for validation
agreement: General support for the simplified approach bounding allocations (maflcko, Yudis-bit, l0rinc)
Contested suggestion to leave room above consensus limits to avoid fragile decode failures (l0rinc)
Accepted deferring peer disconnect handling for undeserializable messages to a follow-up (Yudis-bit)

categories.name: p2p
why: P2 because it prevents peer-driven memory exhaustion from malicious blocks or transactions
Stops attackers from sending blocks full of tiny transactions that each allocate memory

categories.name: utils
why: P2 because it hardens transaction serialization against excessive memory allocations
Bounds input and output allocations upfront rather than permitting repeated large reallocations
